text: Ila Pant, born on 10 March 1938 in the Nainital district (now part of Uttarakhand), is an Indian politician who served as a Member of Parliament in the 12th Lok Sabha representing the Nainital constituency. She is the daughter of Shobha and Govind Ballabh Pande. Ila Pant graduated with a Bachelor of Arts degree from the University of Allahabad. On 20 June 1957, she married Krishna Chandra Pant, a politician from the Uttarakhand Brahmin family; the couple has two sons. Her father-in-law, Govind Ballabh Pant, was a major architect of modern India and a senior leader of the Indian National Congress, and her husband later became a minister. Ila Pant won the 1998 general election as a Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) candidate, securing 38.52% of the votes in Nainital, defeating former Chief Minister and Congress leader Narayan Dutt Tiwari by a margin of 15,557 votes. During 1998–1999, she served on the Committee on External Affairs and the Consultative Committee, Ministry of External Affairs. She has also served on the Board of Governors of Pant Nagar University and as Secretary of the G.B. Pant Memorial Society in New Delhi.
